notes: The 24 cases were exercised through the live local Next.js API route in three fresh-instance batches to avoid consuming the public per-instance rate-limit budget.
Every case returned HTTP 200, status=answered, a nonempty answer, one or more contracted citations, validator=passed, model=curated_evidence_answer, and external_processor_called=false.
The audit records contract and validator outcomes, not raw visitor questions or model reasoning.
